summary: Current raw OPFS composite AbortSignal remains packaged head; linked rev0195 closes the postured Web-Lock no-lock fallback hole by rejecting unlocked single-owner fallback before OPFS store creation unless explicit unsafe fallback opt-in is present. Explicit fallback is labeled in status and lockFallbackPolicy while keeping posture-derived write-budget guards; recovery guidance, posture proof/audit, types, and package boundary evidence were updated with source-budget compaction rather than widened limits.
nonClaims: No Web Lock fairness, quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync durability, Storage Buckets support, Service Worker lifetime, or cross-browser proof.
Explicit single-owner fallback is caller-scoped and unlocked; it is not same-origin cross-tab/cross-worker coordination.
